The '''Code of the Doomed''' was a code developed by [[The Doomed]] during their residence on [[Kesh/Legends|Kesh]].

:''War is a lie''
:''There is no defeat&mdash;there is serenity''
:''There is no victory&mdash;there is death''
:''Through power I am enslaved''
:''Through [[The Force/Legends|the Force]] I am doomed.''
